prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, late 20s goddess, amazon bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — impossibly tall commanding frame with simultaneously the most massive full-figure curves, enormous powerful presence dominating the entire frame top to bottom, legs endlessly long massively thick and powerful, sculpted updo teal hair — full body polished banded malachite fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid stone curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted stone sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING deep emerald-green malachite surface across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID pale-green concentric banding swirling through every section, with a carved geometric lattice relief across every section, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Pose: classical contrapposto stance, weight on one leg, one hand holding the other forearm low in front of her hips — most extreme amazon bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Cracks: the banded malachite body shows weathering in only three places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her right upper arm, and two chipped-off pieces, one at her left shoulder and one at her right hip, where the broken edge reveals the dull raw dark-green stone with a rough chalky surface, much duller than the polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the banded malachite is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps in black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, while her body keeps its full original proportions — thick heavy thighs, wide full hips and a huge bust exactly as massive as before, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved banded malachite right down to the shoes.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, stiletto nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, carved from the same malachite with a high polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, and a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face, ears and entire neck are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: opaque matte classic red lips with a precise edge, a sharp black winged liner, defined lashes, a clean complexion. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved banded malachite.

Background: a sunlit open-air stone terrace at midday with a pale paved floor, a waist-high balustrade, potted palms and a full-height wooden door behind her, bright blue sky overhead, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — carved material everywhere from the collarbones to the ankles. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
